item_data.name: Custom Classic Facial
item_data.description:
Experience the ultimate in personalized skincare with our Custom Classic Facial, designed to target your unique skin concerns while delivering deep relaxation and radiant results. This luxurious treatment begins with a double cleanse to refresh and prep the skin, followed by a gentle yet effective enzyme exfoliation to reveal a smoother, brighter complexion. A custom-blended mask is then applied to nourish and restore balance, while an indulgent 10 minute neck and shoulder massage melts away stress and enhances circulation. This facial is fully customized to your skincare needs—whether you’re looking to brighten, clear breakouts, detoxify, or target signs of aging, let your esthetician know your main focus for a more tailored experience. DOES NOT include extractions however this facial is best paired with our Dermaplane Upgrade. 
Pro Tip: Take your glow to the next level by adding on a Dermaplane service for only $25—the perfect way to gently exfoliate, remove peach fuzz, and enhance product absorption for an ultra-smooth, radiant finish.
Pro Tip: Feel free to request to swap out the neck and shoulder massage for a relaxing hand and arm massage.
Please Note: 
The allotted time for your appointment starts at the scheduled time and encompasses all aspects of your visit, from filing out your facial consent form, getting undressed and settled on the bed as well as post-treatment dressing and checkout. We recommend arriving a few minutes early to ensure you enjoy the full duration of your treatment. 
A $95 cancelation fee will apply to appointments that are given less than 24 hours notice prior to rescheduling to another day, canceling, or no shows. 50% of that will be credited back to you on your next service.

item_data.name: Custom Signature Facial
item_data.description:
Experience the ultimate in personalized skincare with our Custom Signature Facial, designed to target your unique skin concerns while delivering deep relaxation and radiant results. This luxurious treatment begins with a double cleanse to refresh and prep the skin, followed by a gentle yet effective enzyme exfoliation to reveal a smoother, brighter complexion. A custom-blended mask is then applied to nourish and restore balance, while an indulgent facial massage melts away stress and enhances circulation. This facial is fully customized to your skincare needs—whether you’re looking to brighten, clear breakouts, detoxify, or target signs of aging, let your esthetician know your main focus for a more tailored experience.
This facial also includes:
Extractions – Gently clears clogged pores for a refined complexion.
High-Frequency Therapy – Kills acne-causing bacteria, enhances circulation and boost healing.
Extended Massage – Indulge in deeper relaxation with a 15-minute neck and shoulder massage, compared to the 10-minute massage you get in our Classic Facial. *You can request for a hand and arm massage instead.
Pro Tip: Take your glow to the next level by adding on a Dermaplane service for only $25—the perfect way to gently exfoliate, remove peach fuzz, and enhance product absorption for an ultra-smooth, radiant finish.
Pro Tip: Feel free to request to swap out the neck and shoulder massage for a relaxing hand and arm massage.
Please Note: 
The allotted time for your appointment starts at the scheduled time and encompasses all aspects of your visit, from filing out your facial consent form if you haven't already filled it out in advance, getting undressed and settled on the bed as well as post-treatment dressing and checkout. We recommend arriving a few minutes early to ensure you enjoy the full duration of your treatment. 
A $120 cancelation fee will apply to appointments that are given less than 24 hours notice prior to rescheduling to another day, canceling, or no shows. 50% of that will be credited back to you on your next service.
